subject: Renewal kickoff: Springboard account renewal & throughput increase
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie@springboard.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Abbas <samir.abbas@springboard.ai>
Date: 2028-06-01T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + expansion kickoff: Springboard account renewal & throughput increase

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — our current agreement with Redwood runs through July 31 and we’d like to kick off renewal discussions early. Two things we’re hoping to cover:

- A one‑year extension (we’re evaluating a term that includes a stepped discount at +12 months)
- A capacity increase: our Q2 product launch will increase steady traffic ~2.5x and peak token throughput looks like it could double. We’re considering a Dedicated or Reserved plan for predictability.

Can we schedule a short renewal kickoff + QBR the week of June 12? Please include your SRE/solutions contacts and Monica from procurement if possible. I’ve attached our current usage extract for context.

Thanks — happy to share more numbers in advance if helpful.

Ellie Park
Head of Product, Springboard.ai
ellie@springboard.ai
[Attachment: current_usage_report.csv (text/csv)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@springboard.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion kickoff: Springboard account renewal & throughput increase

Hi Ellie — thanks for the heads up and the usage export, that’s helpful.

We’d love to kick this off and make sure we cover capacity sizing, pricing options, and procurement timing so there are no surprises before July 31. Proposed next steps:

1) Quick 30‑minute kickoff (QBR-lite) week of June 12 — I can host a calendar poll, or you can pick a slot on our scheduling page: https://calendly.com/springboard/renewal-qbr
2) Pre‑call ask: can you share p95 latency goals and an expected avg sequence length for the new product traffic? The usage CSV was great; a small note on peak TPS helps Karthik size Dedicated pools.
3) I’ve attached a mutual action plan template and a draft SLA to help frame the call. Monica will lead procurement questions and I’m looping in Karthik for sizing.

Tentative attendees from our side: Soojin (AE), Karthik (Solutions), Monica (Procurement lead). If you want an engineering attendee from Springboard, Samir is already cc’d and welcome to join.

Available times I proposed in the poll: June 12–14, mornings PT — let me know what works or we’ll lock via Calendly.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Soojín Lee
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Ellie Park <ellie@springboard.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-02T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion kickoff: Springboard account renewal & throughput increase

Thanks, Soojin — quick technical note ahead of the kickoff so we can make the call actionable.

Ellie, based on the CSV and the expected 2.5x steady traffic + ~2x peaks, here are initial sizing and prep items:

- Baseline ask: please confirm avg sequence length (tokens) and p95 latency target. If avg seq len > 512 tokens, we’ll need to consider different memory/kv cache profiles.
- Suggested Dedicated profile for growth: 4x T4-equivalent nodes (reserved) with burst pool of 2 nodes for peak windows. This is a starting point — we’ll refine after you confirm TPS and seq length.
- Performance levers we’ll discuss: batching window (latency tradeoff), KV cache warmup, and quantization profile (helps reduce GPU RAM footprint).
- Pre-call deliverables from Springboard: p95 latency requirement, sample payload size distribution (percentiles), and expected concurrent request patterns (cron vs. steady vs. spiky).

If you can share those three data points before the call, I’ll prepare a short capacity/price comparison for Dedicated vs. Hosted with the proposed SLA change.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Ellie Park <ellie@springboard.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Abbas <samir.abbas@springboard.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion kickoff: Springboard account renewal & throughput increase

Soojín / team — thanks for quick turn. June 13 at 9:30am PT works for us (locked via Calendly). We’ll have Samir (infra) and our procurement lead on the call.

Answers to Karthik’s asks (quick summary):
- avg sequence length: 320 tokens median, 95th 720 tokens
- p95 latency requirement: <= 400ms for inference (we can tolerate 30–40ms additional orchestration time)
- expected traffic pattern: steady traffic with a 2‑hour daily peak window that could spike 3x vs steady state during launches

I’ve also uploaded a redline of the proposed amendment (springboard_amendment_redline.docx) and our preferred SLA (Springboard_SLA_v2.pdf). Procurement will issue a PO pending the final amendment; we’ll route signature via DocuSign (link below).

DocuSign (amendment placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/example-envelope/ABC123

Looking forward to the call — please confirm any additional pre-read items.

Ellie Park

ellie@springboard.ai
